question: In Renal cell trials with PD-L1 agents included in the meta-analysis, map the generic ICI name to its brand name.

steps.desc: Filter for Renal Cell cancer type and PD-L1 class of ICI.
Map generic ICI name to brand name.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Name of ICI and output JSON {NCT, PMID, brand_name}. Allowed brand_name values: ["atezolizumab", "avelumab", "durvalumab", "OTHER/UNKNOWN"]. Hints: atezolizumab is Tecentriq, avelumab is Bavencio, durvalumab is Imfinzi. Output JSON only.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
